sentences.text: Heard Mr. A.R. Bhuiya, learned counsel for the petitioner; also heard Mr. P. Borthakur, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State/respondent No. 1

This is an application under section 482 of Cr.P.C. praying for setting aside and quashing the proceedings of P.R.C Case No. 1611/2022 pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1st class Tezpur, Sonitpur.

entities.text: Court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1st class Tezpur, Sonitpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the present case in which the charge-sheet has been laid is purely in civil nature and the present petitioner also obtained pre-arrest bail, wherein the learned Court observed that this is a purely a civil dispute an accordingly pre-arrest bail was granted to the petitioner.

Accordingly it is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the case is of civil nature but the informant as well as the investigating officer gave it a criminal colour and case has been registered under section 420/406 of I.P.C.
Issue notice to respondent no. 2 by registered post with A/D as well as by other usual process,
returnable within two(2) weeks.
No formal notice is required to be served upon the learned counsel for the respondent No. 1.
As Mr. P. Borthakur, learned APP has already entered appearance on their behalf.
However, extra copies of memo of appeal be furnished to him during the course of the day Call for the scanned copy of the LCR.
Till the next returnable date the further proceeding of P.R.C Case No. 1611/2022, pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1 st class Tezpur, Page No.# 3/3 Sonitpur be stayed.
List the matter after three (3) weeks on a date to be fixed by the Registry.
